name: Hidden Lake Dental Associates (Dr. Grasso & Dr. Liao)
what_they_do: Two-dentist family practice (Dr. Michael Grasso, DDS and Dr. Daisi Liao, DDS) doing general, restorative and cosmetic dentistry plus implants, dentures, root canals, extractions and emergency/pain relief. Practice says it has served the area for more than 40 years (founded 1985).
customers: Multi-generational local families in North Brunswick and surrounding Middlesex County towns; older patients needing restorative/denture work; emergency patients.

size_signals.signal: Dr. Grasso practised since 1981 and opened the practice in 1985 - over 45 years of experience stated on his bio page
Two named doctors (Grasso, Liao) plus a staff referenced on the bio page - inference: small, owner-operated office
Open six days a week (Mon 11-7, Tue 9-4, Wed 10-6, Thu 9-2, Fri closed, alternating Sat 9-2)

listing.platform: Not retrieved (Waze and Nextdoor pages exist; no rating count confirmed)

website_review.primary_cta: 'Book an Appointment' (top-right) - but it opens a services page, not a calendar
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: None - the 'Book an Appointment' page lists treatments and says 'Call Us Today (732) 821-5500'; no scheduler, no form
website_review.trust_signals: Doctor bios with credentials and history, office photos, patient video library, 40+ years in practice
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Copyright reads '© 2025'; the Dr. Grasso page still carries Wix placeholder text ('I'm always looking for new and exciting opportunities. Let's connect'); contact email is a personal Gmail address; on a 390 px phone the logo sits off to the right with a large empty band above the menu and the nav row is clipped; no hours on the homepage
website_review.search_basics: Title and meta description name Hidden Lake Dental, North Brunswick and family dental; but only 5 internal pages exist (home, book-online, Dr Grasso, Dr Liao, About) so individual services have no pages
top_issues: 'Book an Appointment' is a dead end - it is the most prominent CTA and it leads to a page that tells you to phone
No contact form and no online booking anywhere on the site; no click-to-call number
Hours live only on the booking page, and Saturday is 'alternating', which an agent cannot resolve
Wix template leftovers and a 2025 copyright make the practice look less current than its 40-year reputation deserves

agent_readiness.notes: LocalBusiness JSON-LD exists with name, address and phone (a good start) but has no opening hours, no services and no geo; a second WebSite block adds nothing. Hours are text on /book-online only. Nothing is bookable online: the booking page is a brochure with a phone number, and there is no form. robots.txt not checked.

operations_signals.signal: All scheduling is by phone ('Call Us Today (732) 821-5500 For Appointment!') under a 'Book an Appointment' heading
Patient portal 'Log In' link exists, so records are digital but intake/scheduling is not - inference
Only four content pages and no contact form - inference: the front desk handles all new-patient inquiries by phone during office hours only

top_opportunities.opportunity: Make 'Book an Appointment' actually book: wire a scheduler (or an AI booking agent) behind the existing button so new patients can pick a slot without calling
top_opportunities.evidence: The /book-online page contains no calendar or form, only service blurbs and 'Call Us Today'

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add contact form, click-to-call and proper per-day hours to the site, and put the hours into the existing LocalBusiness JSON-LD
top_opportunities.evidence: No tel: links and no forms found in the DOM; JSON-LD has no openingHours; hours only appear as footer text on the booking page

top_opportunities.opportunity: Clean up the Wix leftovers, replace the Gmail address with a practice domain and set up automated review requests to surface a 40-year reputation
top_opportunities.evidence: Bio page contains template copy asking to 'connect' at a gmail.com address; no review content or rating badge appears anywhere on the site

scores.reasons: Prominent booking CTA leads nowhere, no form, no click-to-call, stale template copy - a lot missing on a site with only five pages; an established two-dentist practice can fund small fixes but not large projects; everything here is quick one-person work; verified live on desktop and at 390 px.
